batch 611: Customer-success tenant view - guided-onboarding malformed payload fallback (2026-04-01)

**A. Scope:** Harden the tenant guided-onboarding page so malformed Setup Studio payloads fail closed to the existing fallback UI instead of 500ing on missing keys.

**B. Implementation:** **`apps/customersuccess/views_tenant.py`** now defines **`GUIDED_ONBOARDING_SOFT_FAILURES`** and wraps both **`get_setup_studio_payload()`** and the required payload-key extraction in that boundary before rendering **`customersuccess/guided_onboarding.html`**. Extended **`apps/customersuccess/tests/test_tenant_views.py`** with **`test_guided_onboarding_missing_payload_key_renders_fallback_context`**.

**C. Validation:** **`python manage.py test apps.customersuccess.tests.test_super_api_filters apps.customersuccess.tests.test_service_helpers apps.customersuccess.tests.test_tenant_views --noinput -v 2`** - **11 OK**; **`python scripts/verify_doc_plan_density_discipline.py` PASS** (after SOT/log).

**D. batch 610: Customer-success super API - single-school tenant-health soft-failure fallback (2026-04-01)

**A. Scope:** Harden the school-scoped customer-success health API so one tenant refresh/read failure returns a bounded empty payload instead of a 500.

**B. Implementation:** **`apps/customersuccess/views_super.py`** now catches **`CUSTOMER_SUCCESS_VIEW_SOFT_FAILURES`** around **`ensure_health_score_record()`** and the latest-score query in the single-school **`api_tenant_health`** path and falls back to **`{"school_id": ..., "health_scores": []}`**. Extended **`apps/customersuccess/tests/test_super_api_filters.py`** with **`test_single_school_tenant_health_returns_empty_list_on_soft_failure`**.

**C. Validation:** **`python manage.py test apps.customersuccess.tests.test_super_api_filters apps.customersuccess.tests.test_service_helpers apps.customersuccess.tests.test_tenant_views --noinput -v 2`** - **10 OK**; **`python scripts/verify_doc_plan_density_discipline.py` PASS** (after SOT/log).

**D. **A. Scope:** Harden the tenant guided-onboarding launch POST so transient launch orchestration failures redirect back with an error instead of failing the request.

**B. filter before slice on scoped manager-host JSON (2026-04-01)

**A. Scope:** Fix the scoped **`school_id`** path in customer-success super APIs so manager-host requests for workflow failures and admin inactivity alerts do not try to filter a queryset after slicing it.

**B. Implementation:** **`apps/customersuccess/views_super.py`** now applies **`school_id`** filters before **`[:limit]`** / **`[:100]`** in **`api_workflow_failures`** and **`api_admin_inactivity_alerts`**. Added **`apps/customersuccess/tests/test_super_api_filters.py`** with guarded fake querysets that raise if **`filter()`** runs after slicing and assert the JSON stays school-scoped.

**C. Validation:** **`python manage.py test apps.customersuccess.tests.test_super_api_filters apps.customersuccess.tests.test_service_helpers --noinput -v 2`** - **4 OK**; **`python scripts/verify_doc_plan_density_discipline.py` PASS** (after SOT/log).

## Slice - ?11.4 batch 570: Section 7 ecosystem gate - `verify_section7_gate.py` base-path isolation parity + helper tests (2026-03-31)

**A. Scope:** ?11.4 **Section 7 verifier tooling** - align `verify_section7_gate.py` with the explicit `--base` contract used by the adjacent static verifiers while keeping its three documented Section 7 gate steps unchanged.

**B. Implementation:** `scripts/verify_section7_gate.py` now parses `--base`, validates it with `_resolve_base(...)`, rebinds its repository root through `_configure_root(...)`, derives the gate DB path from that selected root, runs both subprocess steps with `cwd` set to that root, and imports `MARKETPLACE_MINIMUMS` from the selected root instead of assuming only the live workspace. Added `apps/platform_runtime/tests/test_section7_gate_helpers.py` for parser-default, existing-base, missing-base, and `main(["--base", ...])` root-threading coverage.

**C. Validation:** **`python manage.py test apps.platform_runtime.tests.test_section7_gate_helpers --noinput --keepdb`** - **4 OK**; **`python scripts/verify_section7_gate.py` PASS**; **`python scripts/verify_doc_plan_density_discipline.py` PASS**; **`python scripts/generate_platform_inventory.py --write`** refreshed generated artifacts. Repeated live **`python scripts/verify_section7_gate.py --base .`** reruns still failed only at step 1 because shared inventory inputs changed again under concurrent repo churn outside this slice; the new helper test mechanically proves the selected base root is threaded through the gate steps.

**D. Docs:** SOT ?11.4 batch **570**; this log entry.

**E. Risks / notes:** Tooling-only change; the Section 7 inventory, catalog-minimum, and key-presence assertions are unchanged. The remaining live `--base .` instability was environmental repo churn, not a verifier logic regression.

**F. Follow-ons:** Stay on one untouched verifier or lint slice at a time and avoid the other agent's active AI, siteconfig hot-path, and generated-artifact edits.

## Slice - ?11.4 batch 521: Operator Phase 10/11 E2E verifier - `--base` root threading + HTTPS-safe bundled test fixtures (2026-03-31)

**A. Scope:** ?11.4 **Phase 10/11 operator E2E tooling** - make `verify_operator_phase10_11_e2e.py` run against an explicit repository root and keep its exact bundled pytest slice green under the current HTTPS redirect contract.

**B. Implementation:** `scripts/verify_operator_phase10_11_e2e.py` now parses `--base`, validates it with `_resolve_base(...)`, rebinds its repository root through `_configure_root(...)`, resolves dedicated SQLite paths from that root, and threads `--base` into the static gate, repo-wide audit, and UX completion subcommands while using root-qualified pytest targets. Added `apps/platform_runtime/tests/test_operator_phase10_phase11_e2e_helpers.py` for parser/base/command-threading coverage. ## Slice - 11.4 batch 771: SiteSettings ThemeColorsForm - treat use_secondary_font_for_headings as a real boolean field (2026-04-02)

**A. Scope:** Make the `use_secondary_font_for_headings` Theme Studio control behave like the other real boolean toggles so the existing `__present` marker can stage an explicit unchecked value on partial saves.

**B. Implementation:** **`apps/siteconfig/forms.py`** now constructs **`use_secondary_font_for_headings`** as a **`BooleanField`** instead of a **`CharField`** with a checkbox widget. **`apps/siteconfig/tests/test_sitesettings_save_runtime_sync.py`** adds **`test_save_includes_false_for_secondary_font_heading_toggle_presence_marker`**.

**C. Validation:** **`python manage.py test apps.siteconfig.tests.test_sitesettings_save_runtime_sync --noinput -v 2`** - **48 OK**; **`python scripts/verify_doc_plan_density_discipline.py` PASS** (after SOT/log).

**D. Docs:** SOT 11.4 batch **771**; this log entry.

**E. Risks / notes:** This only changes the Theme Studio boolean-field contract for that one toggle. Other toggle semantics stay unchanged.
